name: deploy-center
description: What is waiting to go live on Vercel and Render, what is building or failed, release notes and build logs. Deploys only when you allow it.
long_description:
Deploy Center turns off Git auto-deploy on Vercel and Render, so you deploy by hand. This extension lets Claude read its state through the `deploys` CLI that comes with the Mac app: which projects have commits or PRs that are not live, what is building or failed, why a project counts as changed, release notes and build logs.

It is read-only by default. With **Allow deploys** on, Claude also gets a deploy and a rollback tool. They act on one project per call, and Claude is told to ask you before each one.

Needs Deploy Center (or the `deploys` CLI) on this Mac. It uses the same Vercel, GitHub and Render logins as `deploys` in your terminal.

tools.name: deploys_deploy

tools.name: deploys_rollback

allow_deploy.title: Allow deploys
allow_deploy.description: Off: read-only. On: Claude also gets deploy and rollback tools, one project per call, and is told to ask you first.

deploys_bin.description: Leave empty to use the one in Deploy Center.app (in /Applications or ~/Applications) or on your PATH.
